comment_overrides: Force patched transitive deps without downgrading ethers v6. ws<8.18 (GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p DoS, GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx) and form-data<4.0.4 (GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx) are build-time only (not in the deployed bundle), pinned here to clear Dependabot. Same for axios: @coinbase/cdp-sdk (an OPTIONAL dep of @reown/appkit) pins axios at exactly 1.16.0, which carries ten advisories covering the 1.0.0-1.17.0 range - DoS via formDataToJSON recursion, prototype pollution, and maxBodyLength bypasses. The pin is exact, so only an override can move it. axios is not in assets/appkit.bundle.js at all (grep it: zero hits), so this never reached a browser.
